title: McCasland as Pentagon director of special programs overseeing acquisition SAPs
place_text: Pentagon, Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition, Technology and Logistics

tellings.quote: From June 2009 to May 2011, McCasslin served as director of special programs at the Pentagon [music] in the office of the under secretary of defense for acquisitions, technology, and logistics.

plain: From June 2009 to May 2011, an Air Force officer named Neil McCasland was director of special programs at the Pentagon, in the office of the under secretary of defense for acquisition, technology and logistics. Michels tells this himself and draws on McCasland's official Air Force biography, Pentagon training documents and Wikipedia. Michels points to the job because it put McCasland in charge of special access programs (SAPs), classified projects that only a short list of cleared people may know about, which means he would have been placed to see the Pentagon's most closely held weapons work.
